# HostTally

> HostTally is an Airbnb accounts app for UK hosts, made and hosted by HostFactor (hostfactor.co.uk). It tracks holiday let and short-term rental expenses, receipts, bills, Airbnb bookings and income, and exports UK tax year records for accountants. Try it free, then £9.99 a month.

## What it does
- Airbnb expense tracker: log welcome packs, toiletries, laundry, cleaning products, linen and towels, replacement items, repairs and maintenance, vehicle fuel and custom categories, each filed against a property and guest stay.
- Receipts: photograph a receipt, or record an expense with no receipt and get a dated expense record.
- Airbnb integration: import bookings from the Airbnb calendar (iCal link) as guest stays; import the Airbnb earnings CSV to fill in the payout for each stay. HostTally is independent and not affiliated with Airbnb.
- Bills: electricity, gas, water, broadband, council tax, insurance, TV licence, service charge and custom monthly or yearly bills, with a copy (photo or PDF) of each bill and a month-by-month view that shows missing bills.
- Year at a glance per property: income, expenditure, profit, bills, nights booked, occupancy and cost per night.
- Accountant exports: Excel spreadsheet or PDF pack for a month, a guest stay, a calendar year or the UK tax year (6 April to 5 April), including receipt photos and bill copies.
- Email reminders for missing bills and upcoming renewals.
- Works on iPhone, Android, iPad, Mac and Windows PC in the web browser; syncs between devices; nothing to install.
- Data kept on HostFactor's UK servers with daily backups.

## Who it is for
UK Airbnb hosts, holiday let owners, serviced accommodation operators and small short-term rental businesses who want simple bookkeeping and accountant-ready records. Other countries are available on request.

## What it does not do
It does not file tax returns or submit to HMRC. It keeps records and produces reports for an accountant or for the host's own Self Assessment.

## Price
Free trial, then £9.99 per month for all properties.
